object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Tag issue 1, change the document, then tag issue 2 on the latest commit. Open Compare…. Expected: From = Issue 1, To = latest commit. Commit a change to another document only: the same. With issues 2.9 and 2.10, and 2.10 on the latest commit: From = Issue 2.9, also when issue 2.9.1 is tagged on a commit of another branch. When a commit after the current issue changed the document and a later commit restored it exactly: From is the issue before.
